jobs.focus: Next.js, PostgreSQL, role-based access, and production deployment
jobs.title: Lead Full-Stack Architect
jobs.summary: Lead the architecture and hands-on delivery of an Aloden product platform, connecting the Next.js experience, PostgreSQL data model, access controls, and production deployment into one dependable system.
jobs.responsibilities:
Own technical architecture and translate product requirements into an implementable delivery plan.
Build and review Next.js application code, backend interfaces, and PostgreSQL integration.
Design role-based access controls and enforce permissions on the server, not only in the interface.
Coordinate frontend, backend, security, and QA work around shared interfaces and release criteria.
Prepare staging and production deployment, including the Hostinger deployment path identified in the project brief.
Document key decisions, review critical changes, and resolve risks before release.
jobs.requirements:
Hands-on full-stack delivery experience with Next.js and relational databases.
Ability to design application architecture, API boundaries, and role-based permissions.
Experience taking software from development into a monitored production environment.
Clear technical communication and practical code-review skills.
Ability to explain tradeoffs and take ownership across disciplines.
jobs.preferred:
Experience evolving existing codebases and delivering multi-user platforms.
Experience with automated testing, deployment pipelines, and recovery planning.
Examples of architectural decisions and production launches you have personally led.

jobs.focus: Unified schema, migrations, audit history, and consent
jobs.title: Backend / Data Engineer
jobs.summary: Build the backend and data foundations for a multi-user platform: a coherent schema, dependable migrations, auditable changes, and consent-aware workflows.
jobs.responsibilities:
Design and maintain a unified PostgreSQL schema for the product’s user journeys.
Implement backend APIs, validation, relationships, and transactional data changes.
Write versioned migrations and safe deployment and rollback procedures.
Build audit history that makes important data and permission changes traceable.
Implement consent records and enforce the appropriate data-access rules.
Work with frontend, architecture, and QA colleagues to keep integrations and data contracts reliable.
jobs.requirements:
Practical backend development and PostgreSQL database-design experience.
Understanding of relational modeling, migrations, transactions, and API design.
Ability to implement authorization and validate data at trusted server boundaries.
Experience investigating data-quality and integration failures.
Clear documentation of schemas, interfaces, and operational assumptions.
jobs.preferred:
Experience with consent-aware applications or auditable multi-user workflows.
Experience designing test fixtures and migration verification.
Examples of database performance or reliability improvements you have delivered.

jobs.focus: Wireframes to screens, forms, and visibility controls
jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.summary: Turn approved wireframes into clear, responsive product screens, with reliable forms and interfaces that explain what users can see and do.
jobs.responsibilities:
Implement product screens and reusable components from the approved wireframes.
Build forms with clear validation, accessible labels, and useful success and error states.
Represent role and visibility rules accurately while coordinating server-side enforcement with backend engineers.
Handle loading, empty, permission-denied, and failure states across the main journeys.
Check mobile, keyboard, and cross-browser behavior before release.
Collaborate on API integration, interaction details, and regression testing.
jobs.requirements:
Practical experience building component-based web interfaces and integrating APIs.
Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and responsive-layout fundamentals.
Experience implementing accessible forms and stateful product interactions.
Ability to translate wireframes into consistent, usable screens.
A careful approach to testing permissions, edge cases, and error handling.
jobs.preferred:
Experience with React or Next.js product interfaces.
Experience with component libraries and automated browser tests.
Examples showing your contribution from design interpretation through production.

jobs.focus: Secrets, staging, backups, and abuse limits
jobs.title: Security / DevOps
jobs.summary: Support the team part-time by making deployment and operations safer: protect secrets, separate environments, verify recovery, and put practical abuse controls in place.
jobs.responsibilities:
Configure safe secret handling and least-privilege access for application services.
Set up and review development, staging, and production environment boundaries.
Implement backup procedures and test restoration and rollback paths.
Configure rate limits and other abuse controls for exposed endpoints.
Improve deployment checks, operational logging, monitoring, and incident readiness.
Review security-sensitive changes with the architect and help resolve release risks.
jobs.requirements:
Hands-on experience securing and operating hosted web applications.
Understanding of identity, access management, secret handling, and environment isolation.
Experience with deployments, backups, recovery tests, and monitoring.
Ability to review public endpoints and propose practical abuse protections.
Clear communication of risks, controls, and operating procedures.
jobs.preferred:
Experience with infrastructure automation and delivery pipelines.
Experience supporting application teams through a production launch.
Examples of recovery testing or security improvements you have implemented.

jobs.focus: Three user journeys, failure paths, and deadline cases
jobs.title: QA / Journey Tester
jobs.summary: Test the platform part-time from the user’s point of view, covering the three defined journeys, failure paths, and deadline-sensitive behavior before release.
jobs.responsibilities:
Turn the three defined product journeys into clear test scenarios and acceptance checks.
Test the full flow across screens, roles, permissions, and backend updates.
Cover validation failures, interrupted steps, retries, empty states, and recovery behavior.
Check deadline boundaries, time-zone assumptions, and late or duplicate actions.
Report reproducible defects with steps, expected behavior, and useful evidence.
Retest fixes and communicate the remaining release risks to the team.
jobs.requirements:
Experience testing complete web-application journeys and writing reproducible defect reports.
Ability to reason about permissions, state changes, and cross-role interactions.
A systematic approach to failure paths and boundary conditions.
Clear written communication and attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate with engineers on acceptance criteria and retesting.
jobs.preferred:
Experience with browser test automation or API testing.
Experience testing time-sensitive workflows and multi-user platforms.
Examples of test plans or release-quality improvements you have contributed.
